test_title: General intelligence and Reasoning Ability Mock Test 3

questions.question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements: All almonds are lemons.All rabbits are lemons.All meats are lemons.Conclusions: (I): Some meats are almonds.(II): Some rabbits are meats.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.) है।

questions.question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their positions in the letter-cluster.)

Each of C, F, J, N, Q, S and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Only three people have exam between V and Q. No one has exam before Q. Only two people have exam between V and F. Only N has exam after J. C has exam on Wednesday. How many people have exam after S?

Two sets of numbers are given below. In each set of numbers, certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number result(s) in the second number. Similarly, certain mathematical operation(s) on the second number result(s) in the third number and so on. Which of the given options follows the same set of operations as in the given sets?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)116 – 96 – 66 – 2692 – 72 – 42 – 2

Each of K, L, O, P, S, T and W has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. No one has exam before P. No one has exam after K. Only three people have exam between S and K. Only three people have exam between P and W. T has exam someday before L and on someday after O. How many people have exam between O and L?

This question is based on the six, three-digit numbers given below.(Left)  278  405  399  523  104  312  (Right)(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)What will be the resultant if the first digit of the highest number is added to the third digit of the lowest number?
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?72 × 8 − 36 + 9 ÷ 3 = ?

In this question, two statements I and II have been given. These statements may be independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements may be the effect of the other statement. Read both statements and select the correct option.I. Healthcare companies have reported two-fold rise in profits boosted by higher sales of medical wearable devices.II. Increasing interest in personal health and wellness has been witnessed post pandemic, especially among people in their early middle ages.
options: Both I and II are independent causes.
Both I and II are effects of independent causes.
I is the cause and II is its possible effect.
II is the cause and I is its possible effect.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (II is the cause and I is its possible effect.) है।

Seven people C, D, E, K, L, M, and R are sitting in a row, facing the north (but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit to the right of D. Only two people sit between D and C. Only two people sit between E and L. L sits to the immediate left of D. K sits to the immediate right of M. How many people sit to the right of R?

In a certain code language,A % B means ‘A is the sister of B’,A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’,A # B means ‘A is the wife of B’, andA @ B means ‘A is the father of B’.Based on the above, how is C related to M if 'C # D – E @ F % M’?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Father's brother's wife) है।
